searchText: Hardware requirements are documented here: https://eth-docker.net/docs/About/Overview/ Please join us on ethstaker discord; this is an r&d server Is there gonna be any update to the EVM in ETH 2.0, cause we need that like what? optimization to gas usage by regular transfers and smart contracts how can regular transfers be optimized? i am no expert at the level of Ethereum source code, i'm a smart contract abd sfotware dev, but for example Solana has made us look like kids, one blockchain that can forward 50k transactions per second with a block time in milliseconds, with no sharding or connected L2 solutions, i've heard cheapEth has optimized the Eth transfers, haven't looked much into it yet so if we want to put up a fight we need more than just sharding, we need to increase the capabilities of every shard ik we can't change block time that would fuck up almost all the smart contracts on ETH solana has a completely different architecture with very different tradeoffs than Ethereum. this channel is not really the right place to discuss that though, let's move to <#595721451651465227> not much up for a chat jow was going to bed, but just wanted to state we need an improvement to gas consumption by transfers and contracts
